description: Register one outbound event webhook (Pro+ only, POST /v1/webhooks). url (HTTPS required; SSRF defense rejects private/loopback) + optional secret (HMAC-SHA256 signing key) + eventTypes (array of event kinds to subscribe to; omitted / empty = subscribe to everything). Up to 10 per account. Delivery payload = { event, eventId, occurredAt, accountId, data }; with a secret set, an X-Argosvix-Signature header is attached.

eventTypes.description: Array of event kinds to subscribe to (omitted / empty array = all events). Available: approval.requested / proposal.executed / proposal.reversed

secret.description: Optional. HMAC-SHA256 signing key (when set, X-Argosvix-Signature is attached)

url.description: Destination URL (HTTPS required; private/loopback hosts are rejected)

name: create_webhook
